result.title: PathKGen: Pathology Knowledge Assisted MLLM for Explainable Histopathology
result.comment: Accepted to the WACV 2027. Source code is available at https://github.com/nadunnr/PathKGen
result.summary: Whole Slide Image (WSI) analysis serves as the fundamental method for the clinical diagnosis of cancer in digital histopathology. Recent advances in Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) have enabled state-of-the-art (SOTA) automated histopathology report generation. However, MLLMs reason purely through distributions encoded in their neural parameters, limiting the amount of knowledge and reasoning logic they can contain given the model scale. Their black-box reasoning poses another challenge to the human interpretation of intermediate reasoning. We address these issues by utilizing knowledge graphs to inject external structured knowledge for MLLMs to reason over, while making this reasoning component visible. Knowledge graphs are capable of partially externalizing the containment of medical knowledge, an area that remains underexplored in pathology report generation. We introduce PathKGen, a knowledge graph-assisted MLLM for histopathology report generation. PathKGen has two main branches: (1) a visual path that learns visual token inputs to the MLLM using pathology foundation models, and (2) a knowledge path that learns knowledge token inputs by extracting key morphological features of WSIs through querying a pathology-specific knowledge graph. A comprehensive evaluation on WSI-Bench dataset shows that PathKGen surpasses previous SOTA methods while revealing diagnostic reasoning as visually intuitive graphs. Due to its modular design, the proposed knowledge path is complementary to vision-aligned MLLMs and can be extended to other applications by curating domain-specific knowledge graphs to generate knowledge tokens.

AI.brief_summary: PathKGen 面向组织病理全切片报告生成，用病理知识图谱抽取形态学特征形成「知识 token」，与病理基础模型产生的视觉 token 一起输入 MLLM，并以可视化图形式呈现推理，在 WSI-Bench 上超过此前 SOTA。
AI.relevance_reason: 其视觉 token 与知识 token 双分支及可解释图推理，可供核查外部结构化证据注入与视觉信息进入 VLM 推理的路径，并与 latent 推理状态生成形成对照；但属特定领域报告生成应用，未涉及 latent 状态机制。
